# Shared host implementation — superseded

Lifecycle: superseded by [Agent VM](../agent-vm/SPEC.md). The former two Skills, dedicated helpers and tests are retired. This document provides no current operating entrypoint or validation command.

Historical implementation used direct Agent-owned host workspaces, Git-selected source mirrors and explicitly scoped container cleanup. Its evidence applies only to that retired model and does not establish Agent VM acceptance. The source and tests remain available in Git history before the replacement.
